text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High sustained TPM on model-family neptune8b in us-west-2. Tail latency rising >95th pct. Paging #eng-oncall and #eng-sre. Incident ref: 4337771234.

amy_oncall: acked. grabbing pager. current alarm shows TPM ~1.2M over 10m window.

javier_sre: joining. what's the current per-model RPM/TPM?

lee_runtime: latest telemetry -> neptune8b per-family tpm=1,250,000 rpm=18,500. 95th latency 820ms. Spike looks driven by a handful of tenants sending long-chat streams.

maya_product: impacted customers list from alert: acme-corp (enterprise), fable-ai (startup). Support reported churn and increased 5xx.

ran_support: confirmed — acme-corp has seen request timeouts and 502s since ~14:02 UTC. They've opened a live thread with us.

amy_oncall: propose a precision quota shear: reduce RPM by ~30% for neptune8b, keep TPM headroom for streaming. Also propose disabling function-calling on that family as an experiment to reduce per-request cost. Any objections?

javier_sre: +1 to both. Ramp down RPM first, then toggle funcall. We should set an explicit expiry and rollback plan.

lee_runtime: prepping rollout. Plan: 1) set rpm_cap -> 15000 2) set tpm_cap -> 900000 (soft) 3) toggle feature neptune8b.funcall=false 4) monitor for 10m.

amy_oncall: paste the admin API calls you'll run so I can approve.

lee_runtime: sending commands below (using admin API, will use deploybot to apply):

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.internal/v1/admin/quota" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{\n    "model_family": "neptune8b",\n    "rpm_cap": 15000,\n    "tpm_cap": 900000,\n    "reason": "live mitigation - latency surge",\n    "expires_in": 7200\n  }'
```

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.internal/v1/admin/feature-toggle" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{\n    "feature": "funcall",\n    "model_family": "neptune8b",\n    "enabled": false,\n    "reason": "live mitigation - reduce downstream cost",\n    "expires_in": 7200\n  }'
```

deploybot: action queued: change-id ci-433777-A. scheduled apply in ~30s.

amy_oncall: approved. apply now.

deploybot: change ci-433777-A applied: rpm_cap=15000; tpm_cap=900000; feature neptune8b.funcall=false. No rolling restarts required.

lee_runtime: telemetry 60s post-change: tpm ~830k, rpm ~12k, 95th latency down to 320ms. Error rate for acme-corp decreased from 6% -> 1.2%.

maya_product: will send proactive customer note to acme-corp and fable-ai to explain mitigation and ETA for follow-up.

ran_support: opening a ticket for acme-corp with incident ref 4337771234 and attaching recent logs/metrics.

javier_sre: monitoring. if sustained TPS remains >900k after 10m we may need to apply per-tenant burst caps or carve a separate routing lane for heavy tenants.

amy_oncall: good work. I'll compile a short post-mitig note in 20m with timeline and actions. react :thumbsup:

deploybot: scheduled expiry for changes (ci-433777-A) in 7200s unless extended or revoked.

lee_runtime: remaining action items: 1) watch for error regression after funcall disable, 2) verify no non-intended model families affected, 3) prepare rollback commands if customers are still impacted.

amy_oncall: thanks team — leaving watch with javier + lee. will escalate to eng-platform if we need persistent quota changes.

IncidentBot: incident status -> mitigated (initial). ongoing monitoring.
